jobs.description:
We are looking for an Accountant to join our Finance team at Senior Material Europe in Sweden. In this role, you will work with daily accounting operations, financial reporting, budgeting and audit support, contributing to the accuracy and efficiency of our financial processes.
This is a fixed-term position for 6 months (working on-site 4 days per week, approximately 30 hours per week) offering hands-on experience across a broad range of finance activities in an international industrial organisation.
About Senior Material Europe
At Senior Material Europe, we manufacture separator film – a thin film used in lithium-ion batteries, including batteries for electric vehicles. The separator is a key component that helps make lithium-ion batteries safer, more durable and more efficient, supporting the transition towards a more electrified future.
Our production is modern, advanced and operated under controlled cleanroom conditions. Together, we are building advanced manufacturing capabilities in Europe and developing solutions that make a difference – both today and for the future.
The Role
As an Accountant, you will support the daily operations of our Finance department and contribute to reliable accounting, timely financial closings and effective financial reporting.
You will work closely with the Finance Manager and the wider Finance team, gaining exposure to different areas of accounting and financial management. The role combines routine accounting tasks with analytical work, budgeting and audit-related activities.
We are looking for someone who is detail-oriented, organised and comfortable taking responsibility for their work. You should enjoy working with numbers, identifying discrepancies and ensuring that financial information is accurate and delivered on time.
Job Responsibilities

Handle daily invoice processing and accounting transactions.

Contribute to monthly and annual financial closings, ensuring deadlines are met.

Perform bank reconciliations, manual journal entries and accruals.

Assist in preparing the 2027 budget and analysing the 2026 budget.

Prepare and provide financial documentation and supporting materials for audits.

Review financial information, identify discrepancies and support accurate financial reporting.

Maintain organised accounting records and ensure that financial documentation is complete and up to date.

Support the Finance Manager and colleagues with other finance-related tasks as required.

Your Background
We are looking for someone with:

A bachelor's degree or equivalent in Accounting, Finance, Economics or a related field.

Good knowledge of accounting principles and financial processes.

Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.

A structured and analytical approach, with strong attention to detail.

The ability to work independently, take responsibility and manage tasks according to deadlines.

Good communication and collaboration skills, with the flexibility to adapt to changing priorities.

It Would Be an Advantage If You Have

Previous work experience in accounting, budgeting or financial reporting.

Experience supporting internal or external audits.

Familiarity with SAP Finance modules, particularly SAP FI/CO.

Professional proficiency in Chinese, both written and spoken.

What You Can Expect
You will join a collaborative Finance team of five people, working in an international manufacturing environment where accuracy, accountability and teamwork are essential.
This role offers the opportunity to gain hands-on experience across core finance activities, develop your understanding of statutory reporting and budgeting, and collaborate with colleagues across different functions.
We value responsibility, continuous learning, open communication and a practical approach to problem-solving. You will have the opportunity to broaden your financial knowledge while contributing to the day-to-day operations of our business.
We look forward to welcoming a new colleague who is eager to contribute, learn and grow with us. If you are ready to take the next step in your finance career and become part of our team, we would love to hear from you!
Employment type: Fixed-term employment for six months Working hours: Approximate four days per week, corresponding to a minimum of 30 hours per week Location: Senior Material Europe, Sweden Start date: As soon as possible

TECHLA is a Gothenburg-based consulting company working with modern product development across software, embedded systems, cloud and DevOps.
We started TECHLA with a simple idea: to build the kind of consulting company we would want to work for ourselves. We want to build long-term relationships, work with great people and create an environment where both our consultants and our clients can thrive.
We believe in transparency, trust and giving people the freedom and responsibility to grow. Our consultants should feel that they are part of something, have a real influence and are rewarded for the value they create.
At TECHLA, technology matters – but people matter even more. We believe the best results come from skilled people who take ownership, work closely together and genuinely care about what they deliver.
We are big enough to deliver, but small enough to care.
TECHLA is looking for C/C++ developers at different experience levels. You could work on embedded development in automotive, defence or telecom. Depending on the assignment, you might contribute to anything from in-vehicle systems and embedded platforms to radar and communication systems.
The role
As a consultant at TECHLA, you’ll work in one of our clients development teams or alongside TECHLA colleagues. Depending on the assignment, you may contribute throughout the development lifecycle - from requirements and technical design to implementation, integration, testing and further development.
Your work may include
Developing embedded software in C and C++
Working with Linux-based systems or real-time environments
Designing systems, implementing software and troubleshooting issues
Integrating and verifying software on target hardware
Improving development workflows, test automation and CI/CD
Collaborating with systems, hardware and test engineers

What we’re looking for
Experience developing software in C and/or C++
Experience with embedded development, preferably in Linux or a real-time environment
A university degree in computer science, electrical engineering, mechatronics, applied physics or a related field.
An interest in building high-quality, reliable software
Good communication and collaboration skills in English

We welcome developers with a few years of experience as well as senior engineers. In more senior roles, you may also take responsibility for technical design, support colleagues and help drive the team’s work forward.
It’s a plus if you have experience with
Depending on the assignment, any of the following may be valuable:
Embedded Linux, Yocto or an RTOS
Git, CI/CD and automated testing
AUTOSAR, CAN or Ethernet
Safety-critical systems and functional safety
Radar, telecom or automotive software

The mindset we’re looking for
For us, being a great engineer is about more than technical skills.
We’re looking for people with a strong consulting mindset – people who understand that great consulting is about creating real value, taking ownership and being someone both the team and the client can rely on.
You’re highly skilled at what you do, but you’re also a doer who cares about quality. You don’t wait for someone else to solve the problem. You take initiative, move things forward and care about delivering work you can genuinely be proud of.
At the same time, you genuinely enjoy working with others. You communicate openly, share knowledge, contribute to a positive team dynamic and believe that the best results are created together.
You take responsibility for the bigger picture, stay solution-oriented and aren’t afraid to go the extra mile when it makes a difference. At the same time, you’re humble, genuine and enjoy working with people who challenge and support each other.
In short, we’re looking for engineers who want to go beyond – technically, professionally and as part of a team.
We’re open to both employment and freelance/subcontractor setups – so whether you’re looking to join TECHLA or take on your next assignment as an independent consultant, we’d love to hear from you.
Feel free to reach out to johanna.bornemyr@techla.se or submit your application, and we’ll be happy to tell you more about the opportunities.

MAJORITY is a groundbreaking all-in-one digital financial service app that includes an FDIC-insured account, Visa® Prepaid card, money remittance, and international calling. We are built for migrants, by migrants.

Global migration is a 21st-century reality. Whether people are following their dreams, love or new experiences, more and more of us are leaning towards new environments. Our purpose at MAJORITY is to empower the amazing, the brave, and the talented and help them achieve all of their ambitions.

We believe that everyone deserves the same opportunity to succeed. Our mission is to provide migrants the tools to thrive in their new country. We are a diverse group of people from over 40 different countries that come together every day and we're looking for others driven by the same desire to create meaningful products that bridge cultural and geographic distances.

MAJORITY is looking for a skilled Senior Backend Developer to join our Backend team. This is a full time, hybrid position based at our office in Stockholm, Sweden. Developers may work from home up to 2 days a week.
About our platform and MAJORITY
Our work matters to real people. It shows up in someone's paycheck or the money they send home
We build real-time money movement: card authorizations, risk decisions and balance updates that have to be fast and correct
Our backend is C# microservices on Kubernetes, connected through events where every message counts
Our engineers own what they build, from first design to production and beyond
We take on new challenges, not just new features, from new products to partner integrations
To secure high quality code we practice code review and pair programming, we use CI/CD and automated testing
We also have a lot of fun together. We have a lunch run club, play foosball and other games, go to the gym, AWs etc

About you and your responsibilities
You take initiative and ownership, and don't wait to be told what to do
You are always curious and always learning
You take pride in the quality of your work.
You consider the whole system, cover the edge cases and test your codeYou are able to reason through the trade-offs and dare to make decisions for the benefit of the organization
You lead technical decisions and see them through
You think about the bigger picture: how services fit together and how the system will grow
You love to share your knowledge and learn from your colleagues

Basic Requirements
Experience building and running microservices and event-based systems in production, at scale
A track record of shipping real systems and supporting them in production
Solid understanding of distributed systems reliability: idempotency, retries, ordering and eventual consistency
Good understanding of higher level architecture and design
Excellent communication skills in English

Ideal candidate
Experience with C#, Kubernetes and SQL, or similar
Experience with payment platforms, FinTech, Banking or security
Experience working with a growing team on evolving products with many users
Experience building new products with an eye on maintainability and scalability
Vision for product development and for how a code base evolves
Uses AI tools like Claude or Codex in daily work
Happy hacking on new technology, loves R&D
A degree in computer science
A pleasure to work with

If you want to own systems that move real money for people building new lives, alongside a team that cares about getting it right, we'd love to hear from you. Apply by submitting your CV.
We believe in equal opportunity and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

The Opportunity
Hitachi Energy Cooling Systems is currently experiencing strong growth and is looking to strengthen our Plant Design team with a Project Engineer. Our mechanical design work is divided into three areas: system design, design of units that are assembled and tested in our factory, and design of external piping systems, where pipes are welded and delivered to site for installation.
This position is part of one of our mechanical design teams, responsible for designing external piping systems in a project-based environment.
The team is based in Landskrona, Sweden. We are a strong and collaborative team with a broad range of shared expertise, where teamwork is always a top priority.
We are excited to get to know you and learn what you can bring to the team, so we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every requirement. We value potential, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.
How you’ll make an impact
Perform mechanical design work for external piping systems within project deliveries.
Create 3D models of piping systems and pipe supports based on process flow diagrams, specifications, and component lists.
Review and verify engineering drawings to ensure quality and compliance.
Manage material registration and bill of materials (BOM) creation in our ERP system.
Collaborate closely with customers, colleagues, and cross-functional teams such as Procurement and Production.
Work with engineering and business systems including Solid Edge and SAP. 

Your background
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical engineering.
A few years of experience in piping design and mechanical design engineering or closely related engineering disciplines. Combined with a desire to continue learning and growing.
Experience working in project-based environments.
Proficiency in 3D modeling and design tools.
Experience from industries such as industrial cooling, water and wastewater treatment, biogas, marine, oil and gas, or nuclear power is an asset.
A proactive and self-driven approach, with the ability to manage priorities and meet project deadlines.
Curiosity, problem-solving skills, and a practical understanding of manufacturing and installation processes.
Fluent in both Swedish and English.

More about us 
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.​
Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes: ​
Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)​
Group life insurance and additional insurances.​
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank​
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)​
Health care and wellness allowance​
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)​
Psychological support program​​

About Edblad
Edblad is a Swedish jewelry brand with a strong Scandinavian identity and a passion for creating accessible, contemporary jewelry designed to be worn every day. With a growing international presence, Edblad continues to develop its digital business and customer experience across multiple European markets.
In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence how Edblad tells its story digitally and contribute to the continued development of our e-commerce business.
About the role
As Senior e-commerce Content Creator, you will take ownership of how the Edblad story is brought to life across e-commerce, with the website as your primary channel.
This is a key role at the intersection of e-commerce and Marketing. You will take seasonal campaigns, concepts and creative direction from Marketing and Design and turn them into relevant and engaging digital content - from editorial stories and landing pages to gift guides, category content and other inspirational touchpoints.
Working across our international markets, you will consider the audience, market maturity and stage of the customer journey when shaping the message. Creativity and strong copywriting are at the heart of the role, combined with a commercial and data-driven approach to continuously improve how our content performs.
Key responsibilities:
Own the storytelling and consistency of e-commerce content, with the website as the primary channel
Translate seasonal campaigns and creative concepts into inspiring and commercially relevant digital content
Create and develop copy, editorial content, landing pages, gift guides and other inspirational content around the Edblad brand, collections and products
Adapt content and messaging to different markets, audiences, channels and stages of the customer journey
Use GA4 and content performance data to evaluate, optimize and develop content based on customer behaviour and commercial objectives
Develop content with SEO, search intent and evolving AI-driven search behaviours in mind
Collaborate closely with Marketing, Design, Performance, Social Media and E-commerce, including briefing additional content and assets when needed

Who we are looking for
We are looking for a senior content professional with excellent copywriting and storytelling skills and a strong understanding of e-commerce.
You have a strong creative instinct and know how to communicate a brand in a way that feels relevant and engaging. At the same time, you are comfortable using data to challenge assumptions, understand what resonates with customers, and make informed decisions about what to develop further.
As a person, you are proactive, curious, and eager to learn. You enjoy taking ownership, collaborating across functions and keeping up with new technologies, content trends and changing customer behaviours.
Experience & skills:
3+ years of relevant experience within e-commerce content, digital content, editorial content or a similar role
Excellent copywriting and storytelling skills, with a strong understanding of brand and tone of voice
Strong understanding of e-commerce and how content can support commercial objectives
Experience using GA4 or similar tools to evaluate content performance and inform decisions
Good understanding of SEO and search intent
Experience working with content across different markets and audiences
Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken
Experience from fashion, jewelry, beauty, lifestyle, retail or D2C, as well as experience with Storyblok, Centra or international e-commerce, is considered an advantage

An interest in AI, GEO, and how new search behaviours are changing the way customers discover brands and products is a plus.
Location & start
The position is based at Edblad’s office in Stockholm. Edblad offers a hybrid working model with the possibility to work remotely.
Contact & application
If you have any questions about the position, you are warmly welcome to contact the responsible recruiter, Julia Salming, at julia@ecommercerecruit.se (jennifer@ecommercerecruit.se).
As we review applications on an ongoing basis, we recommend submitting your application as soon as possible. We look forward to hearing from you!

You will lead and coordinate technical activities and cross-functional projects, ranging from new technologies and products to improvements of existing platforms. With a broad perspective on both technology and business, you will help turn requirements and ideas into effective solutions. Your responsibilities include:

What we do at Blykalla
Blykalla is a global leader in advanced nuclear technology, commercialising the next generation of clean, reliable energy through its lead-cooled reactor, the SEALER. By combining decades of specialised research with world-class partners, Blykalla is building the backbone of the global AI and industrial economy. For more information, visit https://www.blykalla.com.

What you’ll get to do
You will own the design of the radioactive waste management systems for SEALER, covering the liquid, gaseous, and solid waste streams generated by the reactor over its life. This includes the systems that process, characterise, condition, package, and store waste, from the cover gas cleanup that handles activation products in the primary loop, to the treatment of contaminated liquids from maintenance operations, to the interfaces with spent fuel and decommissioning.
The lead-cooled fast reactor environment presents distinct waste challenges, solutions here need to combine solid nuclear waste engineering fundamentals with a proper understanding of the lead chemistry environment.
Define the functional and design requirements for SEALER's radioactive waste management systems, covering liquid, gaseous, and solid waste streams.
Develop and maintain the design basis for cover gas cleanup, liquid radwaste treatment, and solid waste characterisation, packaging, and storage.
Lead trade-off studies on waste minimisation at source versus downstream treatment, and quantify the impact on plant footprint, cost, and dose.
Interface with the Nuclear and Safety and licensing teams on waste categorisation, disposal routes, and regulatory expectations in Europe (i.e. SSM) and in the US (NRC).
Define the scope of supplier work packages on waste system equipment, evaluate proposals, and steer their execution through qualification.
Coordinate with the Material and Lead Chemistry teams on activation products and the handling of lead-contaminated components.
Support decommissioning-oriented design choices during the concept and preliminary design phases.
Contribute to the waste-related sections of the plant safety case and licensing documentation.

Who you’ll get to work with
The Nuclear Waste System Engineer sits in the Fluid Systems Engineering Team within Blykalla, and reports to the Manager of Fluid Systems Engineering. You will collaborate closely with the Nuclear and Safety, Material, Test and Validation, and Quality teams, as well as with external suppliers, research partners, and regulators. We are a diverse team that is passionate about our work and Blykalla.

 
Who you are
You will be part of a highly skilled team with a can-do attitude. We value personnel chemistry and strive to create a workplace where you enjoy coming to. There are however a few things that we think will help for you to succeed in this role, these are:
More than 5 years of professional experience in radioactive waste management, ideally in reactor design, waste treatment facility engineering, or spent fuel handling.
Degree in nuclear, chemical, environmental, or a closely related engineering discipline.
Working knowledge of the physical and chemical processes involved in liquid radwaste treatment (evaporation, ion exchange, filtration), gaseous waste cleanup (HEPA, adsorbers, delay beds), and solid waste conditioning (cementation, drum packaging).
Familiarity with nuclear waste categorisation (LLW, ILW, HLW) and disposal routes in at least one national regulatory framework.
Comfort writing clear technical specifications, reviewing supplier deliverables critically, and managing a multi-vendor technical dialogue from concept through qualification.
Familiarity with CAD tools and engineering software.
Fluent in English, spoken and written.
Fluency in Swedish is a plus.

Meritorious skills:
Experience with waste systems in Generation IV reactor programmes (LFR, SFR, MSR) or in research reactors with unusual coolants..
Experience interfacing with SSM (Sweden) or NRC (US) on waste-related submittals.
Prior work on commissioning or decommissioning of nuclear facilities.
Familiarity with activation calculations and source term evaluation.
Experience with nuclear waste transport, interim storage, or final disposal facilities.

Location 
This position is for our office in Stockholm.

Do you enjoy hands-on technical leadership where you will set the verification direction, prioritise the team's work and take responsibility for test deliveries, while working closely with developers, system engineers and other test teams?
In this role, you will lead and support the team working with technologies such as computer vision, cameras, AI-based perception, depth estimation and and similar perception sensors, ensuring that they perform reliably in real-world environments.
Role Description
As Perception Test Lead, you will take ownership of how we verify Perception, from setting the overall test direction to prioritising and coordinating the team's work. You will work hands-on with our robotic products, combining physical testing with automation, simulation and sensor data to understand performance, identify issues and find root causes.
Together with development teams, you will turn technical challenges into effective testing, communicate results and risks to stakeholders and help evolve our test methods and capabilities. 
You will also:
Translate requirements, system behaviour and technical risks into effective test strategies and test cases.
Combine testing on physical robotic products with automation, simulation and recorded sensor data.
Communicate results, risks and readiness to stakeholders.
Continuously improve our test methods, tools and automation capabilities.

Your profile
We are looking for someone who enjoys understanding complex technology and turning technical challenges into something that can be measured and verified. You are comfortable working hands-on while keeping the bigger picture in focus, setting priorities and providing direction to others. Most importantly, you want to own a technical area and influence how it is verified, rather than simply execute an existing test plan.
You have:
At least 5 years of relevant experience within testing or development of perception, computer vision, robotics, autonomous systems or similar embedded products.
A relevant university degree within engineering, robotics, computer science, electronics or a related field.
Experience with computer vision and camera-based systems, such as object detection, classification, segmentation or depth estimation.
Experience with test automation and scripting, preferably Python.
Strong hands-on experience with Linux and ROS bag.
A good understanding of embedded systems and hardware/software integration.
Fluency in English is required, while Swedish is an advantage.

Location
Huskvarna. We believe the best ideas happen when we are connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.

Join us to deliver a smoke- free future as a Senior Manager Packaging Development & Industrialization! 
We’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’re totally transforming our business and building our future on one clear purpose – to deliver a smoke-free future. Swedish Match is an affiliate of PMI and has been a leader in the industry for more than 200 years. 
 
In the Nordic region, we are 1,600 employees based in Sweden, Denmark, Finland and Norway working in various functions and teams and together we are collaborating to deliver a smoke-free Nordics. 
 
Role summary 
In this role, you will lead the development and industrialization of packaging solutions for the Oral product category, ensuring they are scalable, compliant, and ready for production. You will translate business needs, product requirements, and consumer expectations into smart, efficient packaging systems that work across the full product lifecycle, from new launches to continuous improvements of existing products. 
 
You will manage and develop a small team of packaging engineers while working closely with cross-functional stakeholders across engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and quality. The focus is on delivering packaging solutions that support innovation, sustainability, and operational excellence, while meeting regulatory standards and business targets. This is a hands-on leadership role where you combine technical expertise, project ownership, and people's development to drive results. 
 
Main accountabilities 
Lead packaging development and industrialization by driving the design, validation, and implementation of packaging solutions that are robust, scalable, and ready for production across the Oral portfolio 
Build and develop a high-performing team by coaching, setting clear goals, and creating growth opportunities to strengthen both technical expertise and leadership capabilities 
Translate business and product needs into practical solutions by balancing consumer expectations, product requirements, operational constraints, and regulatory standards to ensure high-quality packaging outcomes 
Drive innovation, productivity, and sustainability initiatives by developing new materials, improving existing solutions, and contributing to portfolio optimization and cost efficiency 
Ensure effective project delivery and prioritization by managing workflows, aligning with stakeholders, and maintaining clear visibility on progress, risks, and timelines 
Collaborate with suppliers and cross-functional teams to implement material strategies, support supplier performance, and ensure seamless integration across procurement, manufacturing, and quality functions 

 
Who you are 
A strong leader with several years of people management experience and a proven ability to engage, coach, and develop teams 
More than 8 years of experience within packaging, materials, or industrialization, ideally from FMCG, pharma, or a related industry 
A university degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, Materials Science, Packaging, or a related field
Comfortable working cross-functionally and influencing stakeholders across different functions and levels 
Action-oriented, structured, and able to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment 
Curious and forward-thinking, with an interest in innovation, new technologies, and AI-driven ways of working 
Fluency in English is required. Swedish is considered a strong advantage 

 
 
What we offer 
Our success depends on the dedicated people who come to work every single day with a sense of purpose and an appetite for progress. Join Swedish Match and you too can: 
 
Seize the freedom to define your future and ours. We’ll empower you to take risks, experiment and explore. 
Be part of an inclusive, diverse culture, where everyone’s contribution is respected; collaborate with some of the world’s best people and feel like you belong. 
Enjoy flexibility of hybrid way of working - split your time between working from our office or the comfort of your home, where it works best for you in line with business needs. 
Pursue your ambitions and develop your skills with a global business – our staggering size and scale provide endless opportunities to progress. 
Take pride in delivering our promise to society: to deliver a smoke-free future.

Are you a System Developer who enjoys turning business needs into smart, reliable solutions? At FM Mattsson, you’ll work closely with teams across the organisation to develop and improve business-critical systems, with a particular focus on our ERP platform, Infor M3.
 
The role
 
Digitalisation plays an important role in how FM Mattsson continues to evolve. Our systems and digital solutions are designed to support our operations and help us work more efficiently. As a System Developer, you will join our Digitalisation team and collaborate with teams across the organisation to turn business needs and ideas into effective technical solutions. Your role will span development, integrations and problem-solving, with a particular focus on our ERP system, M3. 
In this role, you will:
Develop, customise and maintain internal applications and solutions within M3 and our wider system landscape.
Develop and maintain integrations between M3 and other systems.
Design technical solutions and help establish shared technical standards and best practices.
Develop, test and quality-assure solutions, as well as troubleshoot complex technical issues.
Contribute to and lead development and digitalisation initiatives.
Collaborate with teams across the organisation, internal specialists and external partners, and coordinate external M3 consultants when needed.
Help improve processes and ways of working across the organisation.

 
What we’re looking for
 
We’re looking for someone who enjoys using technology to solve real business challenges and is eager to understand what users and the organisation actually need. You are curious, pragmatic and comfortable working both independently and as part of a team. As you’ll work with people across different parts of the organisation, strong communication and collaboration skills are important. 
We’re looking for someone with:
A university degree in software development, systems design or a related field.
Experience in software development and programming, preferably with Java, JavaScript and Angular or similar technologies.
Experience working with ERP systems or other business-critical systems.
A good understanding of databases, integrations and system architecture.
The ability to understand business needs and turn them into effective technical solutions.
Excellent written and spoken Swedish and English.

It is an advantage if you also have experience in:
Infor M3.
Integrations and automation.
The manufacturing industry.
AI-assisted software development or the use of AI tools in development.

 
Practical details
 
Start date: As soon as possible / by agreement
 
Employment type: Permanent position
 
Location: Mora, Sweden, or Odense, Denmark
 
Hiring Manager: Head of Digitalisation Benny Skoog (benny.skoog@fmmattssongroup.com)
 
Union representative (Unionen): Claes Frisk (+46 70 375 60 34)
 
Relocation support in Mora: Through Rekryteringslots Dalarna, we can offer support for accompanying partners relocating to the area. Read more at www.rekryteringslots.se
 
Application deadline: 29 November
 
About FM Mattsson Group
 
FM Mattsson Group develops, manufactures and sells taps and related products under the well-established brands FM Mattsson, Mora Armatur, Damixa, Hotbath, Aqualla and Bristan. Our vision is to be our customers’ first choice for bathrooms, kitchens and related areas. Our core values guide how we work together and how we engage with the world around us:
The customer comes first
We win together
I step forward

In 2025, FM Mattsson Group generated revenue of approximately SEK 2.0 billion and employed around 560 people across Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, the Benelux region, the UK, Germany and Italy. In 2026, the Group acquired Bristan Group in the UK, which had approximately 280 employees at the time of the acquisition. FM Mattsson AB (publ) is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm.
 
How to apply
 
Does this sound like the right opportunity for you? Click “Apply” to submit your application. We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The application deadline is 29 November. 
We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.employer_name: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
jobs.description:
WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN US 
As a C&F Systems Specialist within our Global Construction & Facilities team, you will play a key role in developing the systems and ways of working that support our store portfolio and everyday C&F operations. 
In this role, you will be the link between our C&F business and our systems, turning operational needs into smart, scalable solutions. You will work across functions, teams and markets to make sure our systems enable efficient processes, reliable data and continuous improvement. 
If you enjoy combining business understanding, systems and people, and want to have a real impact on how we work globally, this could be the role for you. 
WHAT YOU’LL DO 
As C&F Systems Specialist, you will take ownership of our C&F systems and connected platforms from a business perspective. You will work closely with colleagues across C&F as well as functions such as Retail Tech, IT and Security, together with external system partners. 
You will: 
Act as business expert and super user for C&F systems and connected platforms. 
Translate business and operational needs into clear system requirements, improvements and new functionalities. 
Drive and co-lead system developments, upgrades and integrations, including testing, validation and release readiness. 
Develop smarter and more scalable ways of working through automation, standardisation and continuous improvement. 
Maintain strong governance around workflows, data structures, configurations and user permissions. 
Support Facility Managers, Project Managers and vendors throughout the system lifecycle, including onboarding, training and expert support. 
Analyse how our systems and workflows are used to identify opportunities for improvement. 
Support the development of dashboards, KPIs and insights that enable better decision-making. 
Represent C&F in system steering groups and cross-functional initiatives. 
Benchmark best practices and bring forward ideas that improve our tools, processes and ways of working. 
Help ensure our systems support relevant compliance, audit, safety and data security requirements. 

WHO YOU ARE 
We are looking for someone who is passionate about connecting business needs with systems and technology. You enjoy understanding how things work today, challenging existing ways of working and finding practical solutions that make them better. 
You have a natural drive to take ownership and move things forward. At the same time, you are a strong collaborator and communicator who is comfortable working with people across different functions and areas of expertise. 
You are structured and analytical, but also pragmatic. You can move between details and the bigger picture and translate complex system topics into clear business language. 
To succeed in this role, we believe you have: 
Experience from system rollouts, upgrades, integrations and/or digital transformation projects. 
Experience working across different functions and stakeholder groups, for example IT, Security, Retail Tech, Finance or external service providers. 
A good understanding of Facility Management processes, such as maintenance workflows, assets, SLAs and vendor coordination. 
Experience working with business systems, workflows, roles and data. 
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and the ability to identify opportunities for improvement. 
Experience supporting change, developing guidance or training users and driving adoption. 
The ability to translate operational requirements into clear actions and system needs. 
A collaborative, solution-oriented approach and confidence in managing different stakeholder expectations. 
Experience with a CAFM system is highly relevant, Planon experience is considered an advantage. Experience from business development or a similar environment is also beneficial 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION 
This is a permanent position based in Stockholm, Sweden. 
If you feel your experience, skills and ambitions are right for this role, please apply by sending your CV in English as soon as possible. For internal candidates, please initiate a dialogue with your manager before applying. 
WHO WE ARE 
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.
